<div class="research-section">
  <h2 class="research-section-heading">Master's Thesis Program</h2>
  <p class="liu-program-desc">
    Since 2013, <strong>Linköping University's</strong> Department of Science and Technology has been a founding partner of the OpenSpace project. Graduate students in the university's Media Technology and Engineering program complete their master's theses as direct contributions to OpenSpace — implementing new features, integrating scientific datasets, and building tools used by researchers, educators, and planetariums around the world.
  </p>
  <p class="liu-program-desc">
    Each project is carried out in collaboration with one of OpenSpace's partner institutions. Students work alongside researchers and engineers at these sites, gaining hands-on experience developing real scientific visualization software at a global scale. Over 70 students have contributed through this program.
  </p>
  <div class="liu-partners">
    <span class="liu-partner-tag">American Museum of Natural History (AMNH)</span>
    <span class="liu-partner-tag">Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC)</span>
    <span class="liu-partner-tag">Scientific Computing and Imaging Institute (SCI)</span>
    <span class="liu-partner-tag">New York University (NYU)</span>
    <span class="liu-partner-tag">Linköping University (LiU)</span>
  </div>
